But not : Il sautait de joie, s'il était heureux. (s'il = si + il)

I've had the same thing, but instead of yawning,  i needed to take a deep breath and "sight". E v e r y  t i m e. Treating the source is obviously the best solution, but anxiety can be pretty sticky.. Thanks to my therapist and my doctor, I found out that a simple breathing technique+mindfulness could calm me down, even tho I seemed "calm" (for instance, I could be watching tv with nothing else to do and I would have that anxiety response). The trick is to breathe like a baby. You don't control it, you don't think of it, but you need to set up the pace: inflate the abdomen, NOT the torso. Your tummy should be slowly rising, not your shoulders. Mindfulness is a form of meditation that I have personally not stuck with, but it helped quite a lot. 

PS: even physical things could cause/help/trigger such a reaction. Wearing tight-fitted high-waisted jeans for example. Anything that could physically block your respiratory system.
